# agentgateway_llm_api_key (Resource)

A virtual LLM API key with optional metadata, allowed models and budgets.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Virtual keys authenticate LLM requests. Exactly one of `key` and `key_hash`
# is set; changing it is an in-place rotation and the original key stops
# authenticating.
#
# Every key needs the `apiKey` LLM policy. Manage it in Terraform:
resource "agentgateway_llm_policy" "api_key" {
  name = "apiKey"

  spec = jsonencode({
    mode = "strict"
  })
}

# ... or add `llm.policies.apiKey` to the gateway configuration file. Without
# one, the apply fails with a diagnostic that names this prerequisite.

variable "team_a_key" {
  description = "Plaintext virtual key for team A."
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

resource "agentgateway_llm_api_key" "team_a" {
  key      = var.team_a_key
  metadata = { team = "team-a", owner = "platform" }

  # Omit `allowed_models` for no constraint; an empty list denies every model.
  allowed_models = ["gpt-4o-mini", "openai/*"]

  # Budgets are charged independently after each LLM response. `Tokens` caps
  # usage, `USD` caps realized cost and needs a priced catalog.
  budgets = [
    {
      name               = "daily-spend"
      limit              = { unit = "USD", amount = 50 }
      window             = { rolling = "24h" }
      on_budget_exceeded = "Block"
    },
    {
      # No window: the budget accumulates for its lifetime and never resets.
      name               = "lifetime-tokens"
      limit              = { unit = "Tokens", amount = 250000 }
      on_budget_exceeded = "Audit"
    },
  ]
}

# The hashed variant keeps the plaintext key out of Terraform state. The hash is
# `sha256:<64 lowercase hex characters>`, for example the output of
# `printf %s "$KEY" | sha256sum`.
resource "agentgateway_llm_api_key" "ci" {
  key_hash = "sha256:9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08"
  metadata = { team = "ci" }

  # Deny every model: this key may authenticate but not request anything yet.
  allowed_models = []
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `allowed_models` (List of String) Model name patterns this key may request. Omit the attribute for no constraint; set an empty list to deny every model. Omitted and `[]` are different values and are sent as such.
- `budgets` (Attributes List) Budgets charged after each LLM response. A key may carry several; they are charged independently. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--budgets))
- `key` (String, Sensitive) Plaintext virtual key. Exactly one of `key` or `key_hash` must be set. Rotating the key is an in-place update; the original key stops authenticating.
- `key_hash` (String, Sensitive) SHA-256 hash of the virtual key, in `sha256:<hex>` format. Exactly one of `key` or `key_hash` must be set.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Metadata attached to requests authenticated with this key. Replaced, not merged, on update. Keys that start with `agentgateway.dev/` are reserved by the gateway. Omit the attribute when there is no metadata: an empty map reads back as unset, so `{}` would never match state.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time reported by the gateway.
- `id` (String) Server-generated UUID of the key.
- `revision` (Number) Server revision of the key.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time reported by the gateway.

<a id="nestedatt--budgets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `budgets`

Required:

- `limit` (Attributes) Maximum usage allowed during the window. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--budgets--limit))
- `name` (String) Stable budget name, unique within the key.
- `on_budget_exceeded` (String) `Block` rejects the next request with `429`; `Audit` records the overage and lets the request through.

Optional:

- `window` (Attributes) Rolling window over which usage accumulates. Omit it when the budget must never reset. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--budgets--window))

<a id="nestedatt--budgets--limit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `budgets.limit`

Required:

- `amount` (Number) Maximum usage. A `Tokens` amount must be a whole number.
- `unit` (String) `USD` caps realized cost, `Tokens` caps token usage.


<a id="nestedatt--budgets--window"></a>
### Nested Schema for `budgets.window`

Required:

- `rolling` (String) Window length, such as `1h`, `24h` or `30d`. Windows are aligned to the Unix epoch.
